representative.summary: Scientists have discovered a human gene with a remarkable double life: it appears to play an important role in brain cells while still retaining the ability to jump around the genome. Called BC200, the gene evolved millions of years ago from a mobile piece of DNA known as a transposon, but unlike most genes that arose this way, it never lost its mobility. Researchers even found BC200 embedded inside a human poxvirus, suggesting it may have jumped from infected skin cells into the virus.
representative.title: Scientists discover a human brain gene that can jump through DNA

representative.summary: Cancer immunotherapy can lose its punch when tumor-fighting T cells become exhausted, but researchers may have found a way to keep them going longer. Scientists at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center identified a signaling molecule called MEK that can push T cells to burn through their energy while producing cancer-killing proteins. In animal and laboratory studies, blocking MEK helped the cells conserve energy, survive longer, and remain active even in the harsh environment around tumors.
representative.title: Cancer-fighting t cells burn out. Scientists may have found a fix

representative.summary: Scientists have discovered that E-cadherin, a protein best known as the “glue” holding cells and tissues together, has a surprising second job: helping epithelial cells swallow nearby dead cells. Using live zebrafish and mouse embryos, researchers found that cells can dramatically reshape their lower surfaces to engulf cellular debris while keeping their upper surfaces stable, allowing protective barriers to remain sealed.
representative.title: The “glue” holding your cells together has a surprising second job

representative.summary: Researchers found that just 20 minutes of comfortable walking can rapidly stimulate the gut. The boost was brief, fading within a few minutes, but it may help explain why walking can provide relief from constipation.
representative.title: Easing constipation: A 20-minute walk can get your gut moving almost immediately
